compounds.name: Semaglutide
compounds.subtitle: GLP-1 receptor agonist
compounds.summary: Semaglutide is the active ingredient in several FDA-approved prescription products. The specific product, formulation, population and indication matter.
compounds.unknown: Approval of Ozempic or Wegovy does not establish the identity, quality or safety of an unrelated research-labeled vial or compounded preparation.

claims.title: FDA-approved semaglutide medications exist
claims.text: FDA identifies Ozempic, Rybelsus and Wegovy as approved semaglutide products. Approvals are product- and indication-specific.

claims.title: Approved indications have clinical-evidence reviews
claims.text: FDA approval of specific semaglutide medicines follows its regulatory review of product-specific evidence; it is not a blanket approval of all formulations.

claims.title: Unapproved or compounded versions need separate scrutiny
claims.text: FDA warns unapproved GLP-1 versions have not undergone its premarket safety, effectiveness and quality review; compounded drugs are not FDA-approved.

compounds.name: Tirzepatide
compounds.subtitle: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist
compounds.summary: Tirzepatide is the active ingredient in FDA-approved Mounjaro and Zepbound. Their clinical findings and indications apply to the respective reviewed products.
compounds.unknown: A branded-drug approval does not establish that research-sold or compounded tirzepatide is equivalent, sterile, or appropriately labeled.

claims.title: Mounjaro approved in 2022 for type 2 diabetes
claims.text: FDA lists the original Mounjaro approval date as May 13, 2022, and describes its evidence in adults with type 2 diabetes.

claims.title: Zepbound approved for weight management in 2023
claims.text: FDA announced approval on November 8, 2023, for chronic weight management in specified adult populations. Additional label changes require separate review.

claims.title: Clinical trials support the initial Zepbound approval
claims.text: FDA describes two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials supporting the original adult weight-management indication. Results do not generalize automatically to other products.

claims.title: Unapproved versions are distinct from approved medicines
claims.text: FDA warns about quality, labeling and other risks for unapproved GLP-1 products, including certain products marketed for research only.

compounds.name: BPC-157
compounds.subtitle: Investigational pentadecapeptide
compounds.summary: BPC-157 appears in investigational research and FDA compounding-safety discussions. Human efficacy and safety cannot be inferred from preclinical findings or trial registrations.
compounds.unknown: There is no FDA-approved BPC-157 medicine identified in the reviewed primary sources. Its compounding-nomination history is evolving and requires a current regulatory recheck before publication.

claims.title: BPC-157 has not been established as an FDA-approved medicine
claims.text: FDA materials treat BPC-157-related substances as candidates in a compounding evaluation, not as FDA-approved medicines. An advisory committee discussion is not a drug approval.

claims.title: FDA identified potential safety and characterization concerns
claims.text: FDA reports potential immunogenicity issues and peptide-impurity or active-ingredient characterization challenges, with limited safety information for proposed administration routes.

claims.title: A Phase 2 BPC-157 trial is registered
claims.text: ClinicalTrials.gov lists a randomized Phase 2 hamstring-injury study; its registration alone supplies no evidence of successful treatment. Results were not posted on the reviewed snapshot.

claims.title: The July 2026 advisory review is not final approval
claims.text: FDA scheduled BPC-157-related substances for discussion at its July 2026 advisory committee. Advisory recommendations and final FDA authorization are different processes.

compounds.name: Semax
compounds.subtitle: Synthetic research peptide
compounds.summary: Semax is a synthetic peptide discussed in biomedical research. Our scientific evidence review for this substance has not been completed, so no claim of human effectiveness is presented here.
compounds.unknown: Human safety and effectiveness have not been independently assessed by our project. Vendor certificates about chemical samples cannot answer these clinical questions.

compounds.name: GHK-Cu
compounds.subtitle: Copper-binding peptide complex
compounds.summary: GHK-Cu refers to a copper-binding peptide complex. Research and product-marketing claims should be checked separately. Our scientific evidence synthesis is not yet complete.
compounds.unknown: We have not completed expert review of proposed benefits, risks, or human evidence. Certificates on a supplier website concern reported samples, not clinical effectiveness.

compounds.name: TB-500
compounds.subtitle: Marketed peptide research term
compounds.summary: TB-500 is a name used in research-product marketing. Identity, formulation and the relationship to particular thymosin beta-4 fragments must be documented product by product.
compounds.unknown: No completed independent synthesis of human clinical safety/effectiveness in this project. The name on a vendor listing is not an authenticated chemical identity.

compounds.name: 5-Amino-1MQ
compounds.subtitle: Small-molecule research compound (not a peptide)
compounds.category: Not a peptide · scientific synthesis pending
compounds.summary: 5-Amino-1MQ is a marketed small-molecule research compound, not a peptide. Included as an adjacent research substance to test accurate category labeling and document interpretation.
compounds.unknown: No qualified review of proposed effects, adverse effects or human clinical efficacy in this project. Laboratory claims about a sample do not establish medical benefit.
